input_preconditions.inventory: Normalized inventory from verified manifests and pointer checks, not filenames or raw user paths.
input_preconditions.published: Previously successful current-pointer publication, not just an existing generation file.
input_preconditions.candidate_complete: Candidate restore checks succeeded and complete manifest was atomically published.
input_preconditions.sizes: Nonnegative integer bytes; used includes already-written staging bytes; unwritten_reserved excludes those bytes.
input_preconditions.planner_limit: Pure planner does not verify hashes, discover paths, enforce locks or recover files.

scope.count_in_backup: All files inside selected repair snapshots, including raw data and databases, count towards quota but are never individually pruned.

budget.measurement: GetCompressedFileSizeW for file data; metadata and unrelated volume use are handled by the separate free-space floor
budget.compression_ratio_for_admission: Never estimate reservations from a historical compression ratio.
budget.failure: Defer derived writes, retain current index and raw memory, expose blocked_storage; do not claim refreshed retrieval.

retention.repair_backups: two verified complete recovery points per project plus explicit pins
retention.candidate_counts_as_slot: only after verified and atomically marked complete
retention.incomplete_or_legacy_backup: count and report; do not infer restore eligibility or deduplication identity

backup_identity.key: digest(snapshot format + restore ABI + ordered file paths and content hashes + per-domain archive watermarks + verified index selections)
backup_identity.index_mode_v1: copy verified current generation only, never all historical generations
backup_identity.sqlite: cold source under service locks; use SQLite backup API and quick_check; account staging bytes
backup_identity.reports: separate append-only small audit records; reports do not imply a snapshot is post-repair

rollout: cold repair snapshots and restore fixture
safety_boundary: No deletion, source migration, service restart, model request or live config change is performed by this preparation bundle. Existing deletion-policy rejection remains in force.
